settings.text: Shiatsu-style deep kneading with 8 heated nodes
26W brushless motor — strong, quiet, built to last
Wearable cross-straps let you control the pressure

settings.heading: How it works
settings.content: Drape it over your neck like a scarf and slide your arms through the straps. Eight nodes rotate in a shiatsu kneading pattern with gentle heat. Pull the straps down for deeper pressure, relax them to ease off. One button cycles through three intensity levels; it auto-stops after 15 minutes.

settings.heading: What's in the box
settings.content: 1 × SomNexra massager · 1 × power adapter · 1 × car adapter · 1 × quick-start guide · 1 × storage bag

settings.heading: Specs
settings.content: Motor: 26W brushless · Nodes: 8 (bidirectional rotation) · Heat: 40–45°C · Intensity: 3 levels · Auto shut-off: 15 min · Weight: 1.5 kg · Materials: breathable mesh + PU leather · Power: 100–240V

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Ships within 1 business day from our U.S. warehouse; arrives in 2–5 business days with tracking. 30-night home trial — if it's not for you, return it for a full refund and we cover U.S. return shipping. 1-year warranty included.

settings.title: Strong enough for real knots
settings.body: Read a lot of reviews worrying about strength. It has three levels and level two is already firmer than most spa chairs. My husband (rugby shoulders) uses level three.
settings.name: Priya S.

settings.title: Great, wish the cord was longer
settings.body: Does exactly what it promises on neck and traps. Only wish is a slightly longer power cord so I could use it in bed. Otherwise excellent.
